senses.gloss: (b. h.; cmp. כְּוַץ, קָוַץ) [to shrink,] fail, fall away.
units: <cite ref="Bereishit Rabbah 31">Gen. R. s. 31</cite> (explain. <he>יגוע</he>, <cite ref="Genesis 6:17">Gen. VI, 17</cite>) <he>יצמוק</he> (<cite ref="Yalkut Shimoni on Torah 55:2">Yalk. Gen. 55</cite> <he>ינמוק</he>), v. <cite ref="R00588"><he>צָמַק</he></cite>.
<cite ref="Bereishit Rabbah 12:6">Gen. R. s. 12</cite> <he>גזעה</he>; s. 19 <he>גרעה</he>, read: <he>גָּוְעָה וכ׳</he> his stature was reduced.

senses.gloss: (act. v.) to diminish. Tanḥ. Noah 7; ed. Bub. 10 והן גָּוְעוּ אותן וכ׳ and they (the wild beasts) diminished their numbers, as it says (Gen. VII, 21) and there were diminished &c.
